name: tables
description: Headless Airtable-like data tables SDK — bases, typed fields (text/number/select/date/checkbox/link/formula/lookup), records, views (filter/sort/group), formula + lookup engine, and CSV/JSON import-export. Primary surfaces: the headless SDK (".") and a Glide-Data-Grid React component ("./react"). Ships a `tables` CLI over local JSON base files under ~/.hasna/tables. Pure library plus CLI: no server, no SQL store.

waivedSurfaces.reason: Headless data-tables library with no HTTP service boundary.
Headless data-tables library; MCP execution belongs to consuming applications.
